title: Director of GP Operations
text:
Job Title:

Director of GP Operations

 

Location:

Grower/Processor Facility – Erie, PA

Non-Exempt or Exempt:

Exempt

 

Reports To:

The President

Department:

Grower/Processor Operations

**Summary of the Role:**
========================

The Director of GP Operations is responsible for leading all day-to-day operations at Calypso Enterprises’ grower/processor facility in Erie, Pennsylvania, including cultivation, post-harvest, processing, inventory, and facilities. They will foster an environment that is orderly, productive, and safe while maintaining a positive culture. The Director of GP Operations will also be responsible for leading the facility’s managers and teams and ensuring compliance with company policies and procedures and all applicable Pennsylvania Department of Health regulations.

**Key Responsibilities:**
=========================

* Ensures GP production, supply levels, and inventory are in alignment with business objectives.
* Ensures managers are in compliance with company policies and procedures.
* Ensures consistent policies and procedures are developed and trained on.
* Ensures managers and teams have appropriate, accessible, and intuitive systems and structures that facilitate the efficient, effective, and safe execution of their roles and responsibilities.
* Ensures general cultural expectations are communicated to and practiced by team leaders.
* Ensures operations are optimized for profitability while maintaining the expected brand vision of quality.
* Coaches and guides teammates through analytical problem-solving and decision-making.
* Collaborates with Human Resources to mediate conflict resolutions.
* Ensures operations are compliant with OSHA safety standards.
* Directly supervises the cultivation, post-harvest, processing, inventory, and facilities managers.
* Oversees quality assurance, including laboratory testing, product holds, deviation investigations, and recall procedures.
* Ensures compliance with approved pesticide, nutrient, and integrated pest management (IPM) requirements and sanitation standards.
* Maintains and updates Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and required logs, and ensures staff complete all Department of Health-required training.
* Develops and manages the facility operating budget, approves purchasing within established limits, and reports key performance indicators to the President.
* Manages vendor and contractor relationships, including HVAC, environmental control, generator, and preventive maintenance service agreements.
* Oversees facility security, access control, and diversion prevention, and leads emergency response and incident reporting.
* Available for on-call response to facility, equipment, and security emergencies.

**Qualifications:**
===================

* A bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* A minimum of 10 years of experience working in an operations role and at least five years of experience in a management or leadership capacity.
* Demonstrated success in creating creative and practical solutions to increase employee productivity and maximize profitability.
* Experience in a licensed cannabis or other regulated manufacturing environment (e.g., GMP, GACP, food, or pharmaceutical) strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience managing budgets, and multi-department teams.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
* Must be 21 years of age or older.
* Must comply with all legal or company regulations for working in the industry.
* Must successfully complete a criminal background check and meet all Department of Health requirements to work at a Pennsylvania medical marijuana grower/processor.
* Valid driver’s license and the ability to travel occasionally between company locations.

**Physical and Environmental Requirements:**
============================================

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions, as required by law.

* + Prolonged periods sitting at a desk.
 + Ability to work extended shifts of up to 12 hours as needed.
 + Ability to lift, push, and pull 50 pounds.
 + Ability to sit, squat, bend, and kneel repetitively throughout a workday.
 + Ability to stand for extended periods of time.
 + Ability to work in an environment with cannabis plants, plant material, and strong odors.
 + Work can be dirty/sticky and may leave you smelling like cannabis at the end of the day.
 + Work will occur in a warehouse setting where temperatures may vary from warm to cool.
 + Work environments that include exposure to, but not limited to, fumes, dust, odors, heights, indoor AC, no AC, motion, and noise.

Management reserves the right to assign other job duties as necessary. Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

**Confidentiality:**
====================

This role has access to proprietary genetics, cultivation methods, Standard Operating Procedures, and business information. The Director of GP Operations must protect this information and comply with all company confidentiality agreements and policies.

**Diversity and Inclusion:**
============================

*Calypso Enterprises is an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate based on race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, sexual orientation, genetic information, pregnancy, sex, gender identity or expression, disability, or because of the liability for service in the armed forces of the United States or the nationality of any individual, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.*
